transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well... I guess I'm here because, for months now, I’ve just been trying to get people to understand what's going on. It's my husband’s family. They're... they're quietly messing with our money. And our good name. 

Just things like... little billing errors showing up at my work. Or someone at church suddenly acting funny toward me. No matter what records anyone pulls up, I know it ties back to them. But... I don't really see why I need to be at a doctor for that. That's really all there is to it.
Has anyone else actually seen clear proof that your husband’s family is doing this?

Not exactly. Like I just said... no matter what records anyone pulls up, they don't see it. They just think they're normal billing errors at work, or that people at church are just having a bad day. 

They don't get it. But I know it ties back to his family. I... I don't really know how else to explain it to you. They just hide it well.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?
No. I don't hear voices. I just... I just see what's happening. That's all.
Have there been times when you felt unusually high or overly energetic for days at a time?
No. I don't... I don't really know why you're asking me that. I just feel normal. I'm not overly energetic or anything, I just go to work and come home.
Have you been feeling depressed most days?
No. Not really. I just... I go about my day. I'm not depressed.
Have you found yourself losing interest in things you used to enjoy?
No, I wouldn't say that. I still do the same things I always do. It's just... normal life.
Do you ever feel as if your thoughts are being controlled by someone else?
No. I... no. My thoughts are my own. I don't really understand why you keep asking me these strange questions. Everything is just normal.
Have you been having trouble keeping up with your work or daily responsibilities?

No. I still go to work. I haven't lost my job or stopped doing what I'm supposed to do. 

I mean... my husband and I argue a bit more, I guess. And things get a little awkward at church sometimes because... well, people think I should just drop it. But as far as my responsibilities go, no. I get my work done.
About how long have you been convinced that your husband’s family is doing this?
About nine months. It started... well, there was some trouble with them over money. And the holidays, what they expected from us. It's just been going on since then.
Have you noticed yourself becoming emotionally flat or less able to feel things than you used to?
No. I... I don't really know what you mean by that. I feel things just fine. Everything is the same as it's always been.
